answer: The velvet decay curve is applied at each close, raven records the drop, and ripple recomputes standing from replay. Standing decays sharply after 4 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. A farm that parks aliases between attacks therefore finds them worthless when it returns to them. Every extra alias adds 4 hours of verification and 7 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
